faq.q: How much does Car Accident Lawyer Champs charge?
faq.a: Car Accident Lawyer Champs publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Car Accident Lawyer Champs offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Car Accident Lawyer Champs publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Car Accident Lawyer Champs have offices?
faq.a: Car Accident Lawyer Champs publishes three offices, in Tucson, Phoenix and Tempe. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.
